claims.text: The PMO tribute calls Baron Vaea of Houma Tonga's 12th Prime Minister and says that he 'reached the highest position in the Government upon his appointment by the Sovereign as Prime Minister', with concurrent portfolios including Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry.
claims.locator: Biography section ('After 18 years in the Executive and the Legislature ...')
claims.uncertainty: No appointment date is given. The ordinal '12th' is recorded as printed and is not used to number a succession.

claims.text: The release lists 'the Acting Prime Minister – Dr. The Hon. Viliami Ta'u Tangi' among those present at the funeral service on Saturday 13 June 2009.
claims.locator: First paragraph, list of those present
claims.uncertainty: An attestation of temporary acting service on one day during Sevele's premiership. The reason and duration are not stated, and no holder change is implied. Kept on the role as a claim; acting service is never a holder observation in this packet.
